$ python3 -B - <<'PY'
import os, subprocess, tempfile, hashlib, json
from pathlib import Path
p=Path(os.environ['NOODLE_PROJECT_DIR']).parent/'inbox'
before={n:hashlib.sha256((p/n).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for n in ['checkpoint.json','provider.json']}
identity=subprocess.run(['python3','-B','./soodles.py','landing','identity'],capture_output=True,text=True)
print('identity exit:',identity.returncode)
print(identity.stdout)
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='soodles39-review-') as d:
 checkpoint=Path(d)/'checkpoint.json'
 checkpoint.write_bytes((p/'checkpoint.json').read_bytes())
 cmd=['python3','-B','./soodles.py','landing','advance',str(checkpoint),str(p/'provider.json')]
 print('argv:',json.dumps(cmd))
 result=subprocess.run(cmd,capture_output=True,text=True)
 print('exit:',result.returncode)
 print(result.stdout)
 print('stderr:',result.stderr)
 print('checkpoint_semantically_unchanged:',json.loads(checkpoint.read_text())==json.loads((p/'checkpoint.json').read_text()))
print('original_inputs_unchanged:',before=={n:hashlib.sha256((p/n).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for n in before})
